name: cf-cdn-dns-parser
description: Parses Cloudflare DNS backup file (zones/*.json or dns_records.json) to identify proxied (orange-cloud) domains that require CloudFront distributions. Detects Cloudflare for SaaS custom hostname configurations, groups subdomains by apex domain for ACM certificate planning, identifies wildcard and multi-level subdomains, and produces dns_manifest.yaml (structured domain list with metadata) and user_input_template.csv (per-domain configuration spreadsheet for the operator to fill in origin, cache policy, and routing decisions).
